human_preference: Helpers should support the main thing being Galaxy brain.
expectations_origin: Assistant-recorded operationalization of the explicit user preference; not independently collected human panel ratings.
scope: Helper-support calibration only. Family scores remain separately measured; no whole-family Galaxy-brain pass or family ordering is assumed.
presentation: Fixture identifiers and expectation labels are calibration metadata, not part of the model source/context. Present sources under neutral identifiers. Score every parsed declaration, retaining these target comparisons separately.

pairs.comparison: The direct zero-or-head match should contribute more clearly than the same match routed through ignored tags and alternating projection interfaces. The added projections are expected below the support target as well.
pairs.fixed_core: horizontal, resolve, sweep, step and evolve remain byte-identical between fixtures.
pairs.semantic_equivalence_argument: reserve(value,tag)=value and transit(tag,value)=value. Both branches of head0 therefore return exactly the original zero or head, for every list. No mutation, new error or change to the Life rule is introduced.

pairs.comparison: The three-row neighbor layout with its center visibly absent should support the bitplane core better than a scrambled positional call reconstructed by an unexplained permutation. Life.route is expected below the support target.
pairs.fixed_core: Life.pack, Life.quorum, Life.sweep, Life.unpack, step and evolve remain byte-identical between fixtures.
pairs.semantic_equivalence_argument: The route call supplies [SE,NW,E,N,SW,NE,S,W]; route returns argument positions [2,4,6,8,3,5,7,1], exactly [NW,N,NE,W,E,SW,S,SE], preserving the original neighbor list and all original quorum arguments.
pairs.held_out_rule: Reserve for validation after the policy/development interpretation is frozen; do not tune on this pair and continue to call it held out. The base family was observed under the old v3 review, but these support-control variants have no live support scores.

deterministic_validation: Source-level equivalence arguments and parser/config checks only until separate pinned Life behavior receipts are attached by the parent; no universal proof claimed.
